operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to deploy the service on GCP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the service deployment planning going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I originally planned to deploy the service on GCP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Did something change in the infrastructure approach?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. After reviewing the pricing, I now plan to deploy it on AWS.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. Is the new target reflected in the infrastructure plan?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the deployment target is set to AWS in the infra plan.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Great—having that settled should make the architecture and deployment work more straightforward.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I’m updating the service configuration and deployment scripts around AWS now.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier GCP deployment plan and retain the current AWS plan and its rationale.
